background_notes.justification: Elements of a tensor product are finite sums of pure tensors. Write each first factor as ax+by+ch with integers a,b,c; tensor bilinearity expresses each pure tensor as a K-linear combination of x⊗1,y⊗1,h⊗1. Invariance under the generators therefore implies invariance under each Lie algebra element by linearity of the action and subspace closure. The converse follows by taking each generator.
